# Sign-off identities for the DCO check (CONTRIBUTING section 11; P1-n, P1-p).
#
# This file is read from the trusted checkout of the target branch only, so a
# pull request that edits it is still judged by the target branch's copy. One
# identity per line as "signoff Name <e-mail>"; blank lines and lines starting
# with # are ignored, and any other line fails the check instead of being
# skipped.
#
# Only the signer is checked. Two identities may sign the pull request body:
# the maintainer, and the human collaborator the maintainer has authorised
# (Ankar). A signature is the signer's DCO 1.1 confirmation for that
# contribution. Agents add no Signed-off-by themselves and never sign the body.
# The body sign-off confirms the whole pull request, so commits on a branch of
# this repository need no per-commit trailer; a fork pull request still needs
# one per commit (CONTRIBUTING section 11). A sign-off only clears the merge
# check; which role may merge is unchanged.
signoff inpac <inpac@lingmatrix.cn>
signoff Ankar <ankarnassia@lingmatrix.cn>
